paired_wrist_solver_reproduction.interpretation: Reproduced locally from the original numerical dataset using the public CLI. Raw dataset is not included; this checks refactoring equivalence, not independent physical accuracy.

limitations: Private historical-log/raw-dataset regression cases are explicitly excluded by the public offline runner.
Tests used the existing rebotarm environment; a fresh conda solve and GitHub-hosted CI have not yet been verified.
No camera, motor, or real-time performance test was run for this release.
